findings.title: User Agent / Mobile ID cannot be combined with these device columns
findings.detail: These dimensions cannot exist together in Experience Platform datasets, so they cannot share a feed.
findings.fix: Remove either the User Agent / Mobile ID column or the conflicting device columns.
findings.kbQuery: feed.column-conflict User Agent / Mobile ID cannot be combined with these device columns

findings.title: 1 column(s) cannot be included in a data feed
findings.detail: Adobe lists these components as not available in data feeds. Timestamp UTC is always included, so time breakdowns can usually be rebuilt downstream.
findings.kbQuery: feed.column-not-available 1 column(s) cannot be included in a data feed

findings.title: 1 metric(s) must be substituted
findings.detail: These metrics are exported through a count distinct of an ID column.

findings.title: 1 column(s) not found in the data view
findings.detail: Only components that exist in the data view can be added to the feed.
findings.fix: Correct the spelling or use the suggested components.
findings.kbQuery: feed.column-unresolved 1 column(s) not found in the data view

findings.title: The live feed starts in the past
findings.detail: A live feed must start today or later, and 2026-11-21 is before 2026-11-22. Use a backfill feed for historical data. Dates are read in the data view's time zone (America/New_York); this check compares them with today's UTC date.

findings.title: Lookback (14 days) is shorter than the persistence of 1 column(s)
findings.detail: Persisted values older than the lookback are not seen when the feed is generated, so values can differ from Analysis Workspace.
findings.fix: Raise the lookback to at least 60 days, accepting slower deliveries.
findings.kbQuery: feed.lookback-short Lookback (14 days) is shorter than the persistence of 1 column(s)

findings.title: Data feeds were labelled Limited Testing
findings.detail: Confirm that the Data feeds tab exists under Components > Exports in your CJA environment before building this plan.
findings.kbQuery: feed.availability Data feeds were labelled Limited Testing

findings.title: Feed days run in America/New_York
findings.detail: Hourly windows and the dates above follow the data view's time zone.

findings.title: Feed name uniqueness and column overlap cannot be checked here
findings.detail: No CJA API for listing data feeds was found, so existing feeds are not visible. Names must be unique within the data view, and feeds on the same data view need different column definitions.
findings.kbQuery: feed.uniqueness-unchecked Feed name uniqueness and column overlap cannot be checked here
